name: Proxorphan
summary: Proxorphan (INN), also known as proxorphan tartate (USAN) (developmental code name BL-5572M), is an opioid analgesic and antitussive drug of the morphinan family that was never marketed. It acts preferentially as a κ-opioid receptor partial agonist and to a lesser extent as a μ-opioid receptor partial agonist.

pharmacology.text: It acts preferentially as a κ-opioid receptor partial agonist and to a lesser extent as a μ-opioid receptor partial agonist.

summaryZh: 普羅啡烷是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C19H25NO2，為嗎啡喃衍生物，可作為類阿片鎮痛藥和止咳藥，從未上市銷售。
summaryZhHans: 普罗啡烷是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C19H25NO2，为吗啡喃衍生物，可作为类阿片镇痛药和止咳药，从未上市销售。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people, as it was never marketed. Drugs that act on the kappa-opioid receptor can cause sedation, dizziness, unpleasant mood, confusion and hallucinations.
sideEffects.zh: 由於從未上市，人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作用於 κ 鴉片受體的藥物可能引起鎮靜、頭暈、不愉快的情緒、意識混亂和幻覺。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于从未上市，人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作用于 κ 鸦片受体的药物可能引起镇静、头晕、不愉快的情绪、意识混乱和幻觉。

fact.en: Proxorphan belongs to the morphinan family and shares the same four-ring skeleton as morphine and the cough medicine dextromethorphan.
fact.zh: 普羅啡烷屬於嗎啡喃家族，和嗎啡及止咳藥右美沙芬有相同的四環骨架。
fact.zhHans: 普罗啡烷属于吗啡喃家族，和吗啡及止咳药右美沙芬有相同的四环骨架。
